brief: Read the default queue callback and route its low word through overlapping action maps and handler words.

bookkeeping.scope: Complete default callback with actual pop/translation/fallback and complete action router; explicit action/provider/platform bridges.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Mapped 1024-byte action image; signed low indices within that image, nonnegative extended and signed-positive passthrough inputs; valid returning bridges and queue/translation states. Invalid original accesses unmodeled.
bookkeeping.acceptance: 1920 original cases (1746 router and 174 default callback) and four persistent ten-call producer/dispatch/default/action traces match MSVC and Zig exactly; independent alias, signed-index, consumption, truncation and forwarding tests pass.
unresolved: Action configuration/lifetime and actual actions; platform/lock API adapters, uninitialized-output/allocation-fault paths, live input and process cleanup.
